completion_rule: A week is complete only when refreshed UTC date is on/after season_start_date + 6 + 7*(week-1) days, matching the existing model-history evaluator.
leakage_rule: Weeks 1-3 are permanently excluded because the structural problem and C0 reset were discovered after those outcomes existed.
primary_target: frozen production multiplier versus realized active-game PPG for the 21-player migrated LB-to-DL cohort
review_guardrails: No outcome before Week 4 may enter any candidate-vs-control metric.
The frozen C0 candidate may never be rebuilt from later index.html state.
Partial residual-retention variants are sensitivity-only and cannot be selected by this protocol.
No production deployment can occur from Phase 2 automatically.
At calibration review, require independent-window consistency plus no material cohort ranking regression before any deployment study.
secondary_target: frozen fundamental value versus realized active-game PPG and total points
